text: Language is the foundation of civilization. It is the glue that holds a people together. It is the first weapon drawn in a conflict.
author: Dr. Louise Banks
visual_brief: Architectural cross-section of a classical stone arch, rendered in precise white drafting lines against black. Vector arrows indicate compressive forces locking the voussoirs together, converging on a tapered keystone that doubles as an inverted splitting wedge with downward force vectors.
alt: Architectural drafting of a stone arch keystone under compression forces
